title: Fix Mcp App Tools to Use Official Mcp Apps Protocol
description: Fix the semio engine MCP app tools (show_design, show_diagram, etc.) to use the official MCP Apps protocol with @modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps/react. Currently the UI hangs because the tools use a custom protocol instead of the standard MCP Apps protocol with ui:// resources, tool meta, and the App class for postMessage communication.
